title: Webhook message
description: The JSON body Dayhand POSTs to a webhook (docs/webhooks.md). Fields may be added.

type.description: task.created, task.updated, task.completed, task.deleted, task.restored, now.changed, approval.decided, task.returned or webhook.test (values may be added)

data.description: task: the task after the change (task.schema.json); now.changed adds isNow; webhook.test has webhookId; approval.decided has approval; task.returned has outcome, task, proof, source, requestedBy and, by outcome, reason or mergedInto

proof.description: task.returned: the task's proof (proof.schema.json), or null

previous.description: The changed fields' values before the change; {} for a new task
